name: DUTS: Salient Object Detection Dataset
description: DUTS is a large-scale salient object detection benchmark consisting of 15,572 natural images with pixel-level ground truth saliency masks. Partitioned into DUTS-TR (10,553 training images from ImageNet DET) and DUTS-TE (5,019 test images from ImageNet DET and SUN), it provides high-quality evaluation for salient object segmentation models.
